context: A uni student helps a teen friend pick a launch-day gadget
purpose: Teach: アルミ/インターフェース/恵み/ファイナル/オオカミ/一時期/現物/人びと

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、ついに新型ゲーム機の発売日ですよ！『ファイナルエッジ』限定モデル、どっち買うか迷ってて。
lines.en: Senpai, it's finally launch day for the new console! I can't decide which Final Edge limited model to buy.
lines.style: Excited teenage girl bouncing with launch-day energy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。並ぶ前に現物を確認したほうがいい。写真と実物って結構違うから。
lines.en: Calm down. You should check the actual item in person before lining up. Photos and reality differ quite a bit.
lines.style: Calm older university student offering practical advice gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど…でも本体がアルミ製って書いてあって、見た目めっちゃカッコいいんですよ！
lines.en: I see... but the body is listed as aluminum, and honestly it looks super cool!
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen gushing over design details.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かにアルミは高級感あるけど、夏は熱くなりやすい。あとインターフェースが旧型と変わってるって聞いたぞ。
lines.en: Aluminum does look premium, but it heats up easily in summer. I also heard the interface changed from the older model.
lines.style: Thoughtful senior weighing pros and cons aloud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えっ、メニュー画面って結構大事なのに…私、一時期前のモデル使ってたけど、UIに慣れるの半年かかったんですよ。
lines.en: Wait, the menu screen actually matters a lot... I used the previous model for a while, and it took me half a year to get used to the UI.
lines.style: Slightly worried teen recalling past frustration with old UI.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だろ？レビュー動画で『ゲーマーへの恵みだ』とか絶賛してるやつ、提灯記事に近いから鵜呑みにするな。
lines.en: Right? Those review videos raving 'it's a gift to gamers' are basically paid promos — don't take them at face value.
lines.style: Skeptical senior warning against marketing hype phrases.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、危ない危ない…私、完全に『オオカミ少年』ならぬ提灯レビューに騙されるとこでした。
lines.en: Whoa, that was close... I was about to get totally fooled by those 'cry-wolf' style paid reviews.
lines.style: Relieved teen laughing at her own near-mistake.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発売直後は買わずに、実際に使った人びとのレビューが出揃ってからでも遅くないって。
lines.en: Don't buy it right at launch — it won't be too late to wait until reviews from people who actually used it come out.
lines.style: Reassuring mentor giving final sensible recommendation calmly.
